scope: Empty sent-packet tree reclamation, not proof of QUIC/WebSocket parity. Ordinary timings, resource pairs, replacement-allocator diagnostics and loss fixtures are separate cohorts.
decision: Retain simple empty-root reclamation for approximately 103 MiB ordinary ready RSS reduction at 100000 sessions, accepting small measured reliable throughput regressions. Reject worker-local empty-tree cache. Memory and maximum throughput parity remain unproven.

heap_ready.scope:
Attribute a captured capacity heap to first executable frames in its exact image.

Optimized inline sites can share symbols. This is allocation-site evidence, not
complete call-stack attribution. Bucket bytes must sum to the profile header.

heap_capture_recovery.official_cause: gperftools 2.18.1 HeapProfilerDumpSignal uses TryLock and ignores requests on lock contention

browser.channel_note: One permanent global channel remains; initial check wrongly expected zero channels. Other resource gauges zero.

verification.datagram_note: Paired mixed runs include unreceived updates and client UDP drops. All server RX drops zero. Integrity pass does not mean loss-free delivery.
verification.freshness_note: Nine clean/loss/reorder fixture cases, not statistical rankings or identical packet trajectories.
